title: The Witches
author: Roald Dahl
summary: A boy and his Norwegian grandmother discover that real witches exist and hate children. When he overhears their annual meeting at a seaside hotel, he is caught in the Grand High Witch's plan to turn children into mice.
readIf: you want a darkly funny story that is just creepy enough for a middle grade reader.
skipIf: you want a gentle story, since the witches and transformations can frighten young children.
